name: Green Goblin

abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.

signatureAbility:

[20 - 40]% chance per bar of Power to activate a Super Bomb which causes all Bag of Tricks effects to trigger instead of the standard Pumpkin Bomb effect. Additionally, each Cunning and Madness charge increases the damage inflicted by the Pumpkin Bomb by 10%.

abilitySections.title: Madness
content: Green Goblin has a 10% chance to gain Madness whenever opponents attack him. +90% chance if Green Goblin performs a well-timed Block. Madness charges last 10 seconds.
While Green Goblin has more Madness than Cunning, or the two are equal, he passively Regenerates up to 60% of damage taken from Basic Attacks and opponents deal -30% less damage on Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Cunning
content: When Green Goblin gains a full bar of Power, he gains Cunning. Cunning charges last 20 seconds.
While Green Goblin has more Cunning than Madness, or the two are equal, the opponent generates 40% less Power and Green Goblin gains +30% Attack on Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Bag of Tricks - Special & Heavy Attacks
content: Power Drain: drains 8% of the opponent's max Power.
Poison: deals [5,052.5] direct damage over 12 seconds.
Incinerate: deals [4,446.2] Energy Damage over 4 seconds. This also removes Perfect Block Chance and reduces Block Proficiency by 50%.
Weakness: reduces the opponent's Attack by 45% for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Laser Blasts: 40% chance to Power Drain.
Pumpkin Bomb: 90% chance to inflict Weakness.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Pumpkin Bombs: 40% chance to inflict Power Drain, Weakness, Incinerate and Poison.
